name: research-methods-experiment
description: Empirical Performance Benchmark: Jamstack (Next.js SSG & Astro Islands) vs. SPA/SSR (Fahrudin et al., 2025 [Ref 17]) across 10 to 10,000 dataset entries using Google Lighthouse.
